dedupe_keys.name: hurricane harvey smart radar and dual doppler winds

description: The University of Oklahoma team publishes mobile SMART radar and Corpus Christi WSR-88D observations from Hurricane Harvey’s landfall on 25–26 August 2017. The Zenodo deposit contains preliminary and final quality-controlled Doppler velocities, unmodified polarimetric measurements and retrieved three-dimensional dual-Doppler winds. Version 2 separates the products into archives with README files; the describing paper documents NetCDF wind fields. Access is free under CC-BY-4.0. These measurements can validate hurricane wind-field simulations used to estimate loads on buildings, power assets and coastal facilities. The wind retrievals are derived from the companion radar volumes and should not be treated as independent observations. Coverage is limited to the observing geometry and landfall period, with different quality-control stages included. Users must select the appropriate product, use coverage masks and account for retrieval uncertainty. The dataset is an event benchmark, not a long-term hurricane climatology.
